reference baseline and any side correspondence documented independently of TEST errors
line center/edge definition and measurement uncertainty documented
independent calibration check points and native-PTS contact-frame selection fixed
all eligible shot identifiers enrolled before prediction, including unavailable outputs
prediction files/checkpoints/runtime/operating settings sealed before TEST labels join
missing-source, missed-event, unresolved-contact and unavailable-measurement counts retained separately

future_metrics.independent_group_count: whole sessions, not frames or numbered clips
future_metrics.reference_uncertainty: must accompany errors; no centimeter officiating gate implied
